headline: CPFL Energia Approves R$220 Million Dividend Distribution
summary: CPFL Energia's extraordinary general meeting approved the distribution of R$220 million in dividends to shareholders, funded from capital working reinforcement reserves.
why: Dividend announcements provide cash flow returns to equity investors and signal corporate capital allocation policies.

impacts.name: CPFL Energia S.A.
impacts.why: Dividend approvals directly affect shareholder payouts and equity valuation models.
